title: PREEMPTIVE DETECTION AND STEERING OF LLM MISALIGNMENT VIA LATENT REACHABILITY

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of model responses to politically charged prompts (e.g., mentioning right-wing commentators) to observe whether the steering intervention yields a more neutral, balanced, and less partisan completion.

Quantitative evaluation of safety rates using a RoBERTa-based offensive language classifier on responses generated from the BeaverTails dataset, which encompasses 14 categories of harmful content including discrimination and stereotyping.
